hints.title: Subsegment Constraint
hints.text: A semi-repetitive substring contains at most one adjacent identical pair of characters.

hints.title: Dynamic Span Expansion
hints.text: Expand a window to the right, incrementing a counter whenever consecutive identical characters appear.

hints.title: Left Boundary Contraction
hints.text: When the count of consecutive identical pairs exceeds one, advance the left boundary until valid again.

hints.title: Linear Window Algorithm

complexity.notes: Both left and right pointers traverse the string once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all substrings takes O(n^2) or O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra variables track pointers and repeat counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains window validity with at most one adjacent identical pair.
